title: Odesa Opera and Ballet Theatre
geometryBasis: Native surveyed-mapping polygons for the named theatre building, fifteen associated structural features and the exact original public-domain Qualla front image.
sectionBasis: Curved three-tier Baroque frontage with rusticated base, a taller projecting multistory arched portico and paired columns. The mapped stage-house and crown reach 37 and 40.5 metres.
limitations: Only the building exterior is modeled. Statuary and ornamental profiles will be simplified at catalog scale.
Mapped building parts and roof envelope are combined with an exact original front photograph. Rear openings and profiles without measurements are approximate.
